reproducibility_note: Answers were generated with this many concurrent Ollama calls, and concurrent inference is not bit-identical to one-at-a-time inference even at temperature 0. The response cache under data/eval/ollama_cache on the machine that produced these numbers is the reproducibility source; a fresh clone regenerates it.
